value.rationale: Simultaneous resetting is a physical search protocol with published mean-optimality transition; controlling absolute and relative finishing-time risk in addition to mean is a motivated independent question. The certified 7–12 transition shows qualitative conflict between mean, variance and CV risk, not an arbitrary single numerical value. Exact strict finite-population sign classifications are immediately actionable and not derivable from the reported mean threshold alone.
